# Styx — The MCP-Native AI Gateway

> Connect any AI tool to every model provider through the Model Context Protocol.

## What is Styx?

Styx is the first AI gateway built for MCP (Model Context Protocol). It lets AI tools like Claude Desktop, Cursor, and Windsurf access every model provider — OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Mistral — through a single MCP connection. No code changes, no multiple API keys, no vendor lock-in.

Styx also works as an OpenAI-compatible REST API gateway for programmatic access.

## Quick Start

### MCP (recommended)

Install the Styx MCP server:

```bash
npx styx-mcp --api-key $STYX_API_KEY
```

Or via pip:

```bash
pip install styx-gateway
styx-mcp --api-key $STYX_API_KEY
```

Add to claude_desktop_config.json:

```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "styx": {
      "command": "npx",
      "args": ["styx-mcp"],
      "env": {
        "STYX_API_KEY": "sk-styx-xxx",
        "STYX_TOKEN": "your-jwt-token"
      }
    }
  }
}
```

### REST API

Use any OpenAI SDK — just change the base URL:

Python:
```python
from openai import OpenAI
client = OpenAI(api_key="sk-styx-xxx", base_url="https://api.styx.sh/v1")
response = client.chat.completions.create(
    model="gpt-4o",
    messages=[{"role": "user", "content": "Hello!"}]
)
```

Node.js:
```javascript
import OpenAI from "openai";
const client = new OpenAI({ apiKey: "sk-styx-xxx", baseURL: "https://api.styx.sh/v1" });
const response = await client.chat.completions.create({
    model: "gpt-4o",
    messages: [{ role: "user", content: "Hello!" }]
});
```

## MCP Tools

When connected via MCP, Styx exposes 9 tools:

| Tool | Description |
|------|-------------|
| styx_send_request | Send chat completions through the gateway |
| styx_list_models | List all available AI models with pricing |
| styx_switch_model | Set a default model for the session |
| styx_list_projects | List all projects |
| styx_create_project | Create a new project |
| styx_list_api_keys | List API keys (prefixes only) |
| styx_create_api_key | Create a new API key |
| styx_check_usage | Get usage statistics |
| styx_manage_providers | Manage BYOK provider keys |

## Supported Models

Styx supports models from these providers:

- OpenAI: gpt-4o, gpt-4o-mini, gpt-4-turbo, o1-preview, o1-mini
- Anthropic: claude-sonnet-4-20250514, claude-3-5-haiku-20241022, claude-3-opus
- Google: gemini-2.0-flash, gemini-1.5-pro, gemini-1.5-flash
- Mistral: mistral-large-latest, mistral-medium, mistral-small

Switch between any model by changing one parameter. No new API keys needed.

## Billing Modes

### Charon (BYOK — Bring Your Own Keys)
Use your own provider API keys. Zero markup. Styx charges for request volume only.

| Plan | Price | Requests/month |
|------|-------|----------------|
| Shade | Free | 10,000 |
| Obol | $29/mo | 100,000 |
| Ferryman | $99/mo | 1,000,000 |
| Titan | $499/mo | Unlimited |

### Achilles (Managed)
Buy credits. Styx handles all provider keys and billing.

| Plan | Price | Credits/month |
|------|-------|---------------|
| Spark | $10/mo | 10,000 |
| Blaze | $50/mo | 60,000 |
| Inferno | $200/mo | 300,000 |

## Key Features

### MCP Native
First AI gateway built for the Model Context Protocol. Your tools discover capabilities automatically — no integration code needed.

### Multi-Provider Access
Access OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, and Mistral through a single API key. Switch models by changing one parameter.

### Semantic Caching
Vector-based semantic cache recognizes similar queries and returns cached responses instantly. Saves up to 80% on API costs.

### Automatic Failover
Circuit breaker pattern with health monitoring. If one provider goes down, Styx automatically routes to the next available provider. Zero downtime.

### BYOK (Bring Your Own Keys)
Use your existing provider API keys through Styx. Zero markup — you pay providers directly at their published rates.

### Real-Time Analytics
Dashboard with request volumes, cost tracking, latency percentiles, provider distribution, and per-model breakdowns.

## Architecture

```
Client/MCP Tool -> Styx Gateway -> Provider (OpenAI/Anthropic/Google/Mistral)
                       |
                  Features:
                  - API key validation
                  - Semantic cache check
                  - Smart routing
                  - Cost tracking
                  - Request logging
                  - Automatic fallover
```

## Configuration

| Variable | Required | Default | Description |
|----------|----------|---------|-------------|
| STYX_API_KEY | For requests | — | API key (starts with sk-styx-) |
| STYX_TOKEN | For management | — | JWT auth token |
| STYX_API_URL | No | https://api.styx.sh | Backend API URL |
| STYX_PROXY_URL | No | https://proxy.styx.sh | Proxy URL |

- Claude Desktop (Anthropic)
- Claude Code (CLI)
